parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number to return.

- Minimum value: 1

- Default value: 1

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of items to return per page.

- Maximum value: 100

- Default value: 10

parameters.name: SearchKey
parameters.description: The keyword to filter query results.

parameters.name: TenantName
parameters.description:
The tenant name.
The name must be 2 to 20 characters long, start with a letter or an underscore, and consist of letters, digits, and underscores (\_). The name is case-sensitive. "sys" is a reserved name and cannot be used.
